prior_findings_closed: All prior resume_failed, event-correlation, and durability-scope findings are closed.

findings.summary: A stale unpaused admission publication can complete after pause and reopen CW-11 review admission
bind_run(B) can race an in-progress pause(A), contaminate B with A pause state, and abort pause with PausePolicyError
peer session can switch after resume validation; replacement peer is resumed and old binding is published unpaused without ack/post-probe identity checks
actual runtime probe passes without projecting confirmed file changes/running processes and does not exercise manual TUI activity independence during pause

runtime_false_pass: Changing manager_files to invalid and host_process_count to zero did not make qualifies fail; projection was fed None for both fields.
